Year-End Party Season Only Horumon "Kiwami" Course7 items

Available only in November and December, this Year-End Party season special course lets you fully enjoy Yakiniku Horumon Arai Ya’s Koenji location’s proud Horumon. It features four show-stopping BIG-series items — menabura (face fat), a whole grilled Outside skirt, Cheek steak, and a whole grilled Marucho — plus a 7-item assorted platter of today’s Horumon, making it a highly satisfying choice for Horumon lovers.

With hearty items like whole-grilled Outside skirt and whole-grilled Marucho, it’s a satisfying choice for year-end banquets.

	
Reserve

Savor Yakiniku Horumon Arai Ya’s signature Wagyu in a luxurious menu perfectly suited for year-end gatherings.

Year-End Party Season Only Horumon "Kiwami" Course7 items

Available only in November and December, this Year-End Party season special course lets you fully enjoy Yakiniku Horumon Arai Ya’s Koenji location’s proud Horumon. It features four show-stopping BIG-series items — menabura (face fat), a whole grilled Outside skirt, Cheek steak, and a whole grilled Marucho — plus a 7-item assorted platter of today’s Horumon, making it a highly satisfying choice for Horumon lovers.

	
Reserve

All you can drink

2H All-You-Can-Drink Horumon "Kiwami" Course7 items

With hearty items like whole-grilled Outside skirt and whole-grilled Marucho, it’s a satisfying choice for year-end banquets.

	
Reserve

JPY9,350（Price including tax）per person
 2 - 27

Savor Yakiniku Horumon Arai Ya’s signature Wagyu in a luxurious menu perfectly suited for year-end gatherings.
